g.text: The latest Claude models write runs of correct residues; on shuffled proteins they cannot

text.style: font-size: 6.2px; font-family: Arial, 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif; fill: var(--fig-muted, #6b7385)

g.text: 668 little-studied proteins. Share of replies whose first k residues are all right. On real proteins, Fable 5.2 gets

text.style: font-size: 6.2px; font-family: Arial, 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif; fill: var(--fig-muted, #6b7385)

g.text: 11% to 5 in a row and 2.6% to all 10, Opus 5.5 3.0% and 0.4%; on shuffled proteins neither gets past 3.

text.style: font-size: 6.2px; font-family: Arial, 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif; fill: var(--fig-muted, #6b7385)

g.text: Hollow points: raw continuation of the FASTA text (Gemini 2.5 Pro, open-weight models).
